description: Shared WebGPU minimum compute limits for Pixelocity's 14-entry bind group (bindings 0–13) plus the opt-in group-1 sim ring (bind_group1.json). Keep in sync with src/renderer/webgpuDevicePolicy.ts and wasm_renderer/device.cpp CheckLimit + requiredLimits.

notes.maxBindGroups: Group 0 (14-entry catalog contract) + opt-in group 1 sim ring (src/contracts/bind_group1.json). WebGPU base limit is 4.
notes.maxStorageBuffersPerShaderStage: 2 in group 0 (extraBuffer, plasmaBuffer) + 2 in group 1 (simState, simIndex). Was 2 before the sim ring. WebGPU base limit is 8.
notes.maxUniformBuffersPerShaderStage: 1 in group 0 (u) + 1 in group 1 (simParams). WebGPU base limit is 12.
notes.maxTextureDimension2D: Comfortable floor (WebGPU base limit is 8192; minimum viable 4096). Never derive this from maxBufferSize, pixel count, width*height, or a mis-ordered init arg / heap pointer.
